svg.text: Two clocks — one event machine, ten reconciled ones, meeting only at the work order and the exit record
the operator on top · the stores and the pure pass in the middle · the one free state below · nothing else crosses
three paths in · one artifact out
applied iff the target is there
+ state proposed · − word approve or drop
+ session kept · − word finish or keep
+ offer record · − word accept or reject
every waiting-on-operator state must name a row — checked in CI
ledger read — the backlog is a query
state proven by a store · every guard is a query over the snapshot
containment · delegation · attachment — the only three relations
written from the sources · read as truth by nobody
advances on evidence from herdr, never on a tick
the one free state in the model

g.text: a session never writes another machine; a machine never interrupts a session
